author: Michael Larabel
description: Tonight Valve released a big Steam client beta update with a number of new features and fixes...
title: Steam Client Beta Improves Big Picture Mode, Several Linux Enhancements

author: Michael Larabel
description: A ReactOS developer for this open-source operating system project striving for binary compatibility with Windows drivers and applications has achieved an intriguing software stack. With the experimental ReactOS ARM64 build for running on 64-bit ARM hardware like Raspberry Pi SBCs, he's paired that "open-source Windows" OS with the open-source FEX emulator for in turn being able to run Windows x64 games/apps on ReactOS atop native ARM hardware...
title: ReactOS Dev Gets FEX Running For x86_64 Games On This "Open-Source Windows" OS Under ARM

author: Michael Larabel
description: Earlier this year the 3mdeb firmware consulting firm ported AMD openSIL CPU open-source silicon initialization library and Coreboot to an EPYC motherboard, the Gigabyte MZ33-AR1. Their next feat now achieved is bringing AMD openSIL and Coreboot to a desktop AMD Ryzen motherboard with their downstream Dasharo firmware solution. I have been running this alternative firmware on the MSI PRO B850P WiFi motherboard and it's been working out and performing well as an alternative to the closed-up motherboard firmware.
title: Running AMD openSIL + Coreboot On The First Available Ryzen AM5 Motherboard

author: Michael Larabel
description: Following last month's initial release candidate of XWayland 26.1 with its many new features, a second release  candidate is now available with a number of fixes...
title: XWayland 26.1 RC2 Released For Testing With More Fixes

author: Michael Larabel
description: System76 today unveiled their newest desktop computer as the Thelio Mira AI. The System76 Thelio Mira AI is designed for multi-GPU AI training, model fine-tuning, AI inferencing, computer vision and image generation tasks on tthe AI side. Or with its AMD Ryzen 9000 series CPU and NVIDIA/AMD GPU options is also a good candidate for simulations and other HPC-type workloads...
title: System76 Launches The Thelio Mira AI With AMD Ryzen + NVIDIA Or AMD Graphics

author: Michael Larabel
description: The first alpha release of the upcoming OpenSSL 4.1 release is now available for testing with some GREASE and DTLS 1.3 support along with more AVX-512 performance optimizations...
title: OpenSSL 4.1 Alpha 1 Released With DTLS 1.3, GREASE & More AVX-512 Optimizations

author: Michael Larabel
description: NVIDIA today debuted the 615.71.09 Linux driver that comes with a number of improvements, especially from the Vulkan API perspective...
title: NVIDIA 615.71.09 Linux Driver Released With Vulkan Improvements

author: Michael Larabel
description: In addition to the still-pending kernel work for improving the in-kernel Zstd code, sepaarately the Btrfs file-system driver has an improvement on the way in its decompression code path for the Zstd transparent file-system compression...
title: A Nice Improvement Coming For Faster Btrfs Zstd Decompression

author: Michael Larabel
description: It's nice seeing a new GNU Compiler Collection (GCC) patch out of AMD today that is a general optimization for the x86_64 compiler code and not exclusively tied to their Zen processors. It's an Extended Load Optimization to benefit code where there is a narrower type and then an arithmetic type with a wider type...
title: AMD Posts New GCC Compiler Patch For Extended Load Optimization

author: Michael Larabel
description: Announced a few months back was YSERVER as a modern X11 server written in the Rust programming language. In getting the project off the ground quickly and given the size of X11, it was largely vibe coded with Claude Code. The project continues and is attracting contributions from more users with today marking the YSERVER 1.5 release...
title: YSERVER 1.5 Released With Reverse PRIME Support & Other New Features
